title: LOOK: Flowers laid for public personalities in Manila North Cemetery for Undas 2026
summary: The Manila City government has laid flowers for several popular personalities, including former presidents of the Philippines, at the Manila North Cemetery for Undas 2026.

blocks.text: The Manila City government has laid flowers for several popular personalities, including former presidents of the Philippines, at the Manila North Cemetery for Undas 2026.
According to images posted by Pamela Adriano of Super Radyo dzBB, these personalities include the late presidents Sergio Osmeña, Manuel Roxas, and Ramon Magsaysay.
Flowers were also offered for the late celebrity couple Susan Roces and Ronald Allan Kelley Poe, more popularly known as Fernando Poe Jr. or simply "FPJ."
Authorities said earlier this week that some two million visitors are expected to arrive at the Manila North Cemetery, one of most visited in the country during the traditional Undas season.
Cemetery officials have launched services to help people find the burial spots of their dearly departed, as well as free rides for senior citizens. — VDV, GMA News
